name: Necrotic Resurrection
notes: Each cast costs 3 Favor; at fewer than 3 Favor the rest goes into Heresy (e.g. 1 Favor -> 2 Heresy). Risen summons can't be healed: the Lantern's Holy Light and other ally heals skip them (vanilla PlayerHeal heals any actor on your team, so the build has to exclude them). Level numbers are a first pass. Cast on the body you aim at, takes 3 seconds to complete, 5 seconds for an elite, 10 for a boss.; last until killed or decay. they lose 1% health every 3 seconds, boss loses it every 9 seconds; past the summon cap oldest dies; boss resurection must be unlocked through a certain orb mod
summary: Reanimate an intact body left by Call of Heresy as a loyal summon that fights for you. Their health decays slowly over time. Each summon reduces your favor by 3 stacks and can bring you into negative standing.
